title: AI Agent for Public Tender Extraction in the BOE: Automate your B2B Specifications
body:
¿How many public tenders is your SMB losing just because you do not have a team of analysts reading mountains of two-hundred-page PDFs every single morning?

The Official State Gazette (BOE) and procurement portals are packed with million-dollar opportunities, but bureaucratic language and the density of technical specifications act as an insurmountable barrier for small businesses. Engineers and commercial directors spend entire days highlighting endless documents only to discover, on page one hundred and eighty, that they do not meet a specific solvency criterion. This operational bottleneck causes medium-sized companies to only apply for a fraction of public tenders, leaving hundreds of thousands of euros in potential revenue on the table out of sheer lack of time and review resources.

The trap of standard PDF readers

Many entrepreneurs try to fix this by uploading specifications to consumer Artificial Intelligence tools or conventional document readers. The reality is that these systems suffer from severe hallucinations when facing legal texts structured in columns, miss critical penalty clauses hidden in the fine print, and collapse due to token limits when the document exceeds a certain length. Relying on a generic AI for public tenders is the fastest formula to be disqualified or to sign a ruinous contract.

Our solution: An AI Agent with Semantic Ingestion and Deterministic Logic

At LANZAESTUDIO we have developed a specialized AI Agent for public procurement that automates the triage and extraction of critical data from BOE specifications. We do not just search for keywords; the architecture processes the document using advanced segmentation and semantic analysis techniques to understand the actual context of the tender.

  1. Direct connection via API: We daily crawl official gazettes and extract PDFs of new tenders based on your specific electrical or industrial activity sector.
  2. Structured processing: We fragment the document using layout-awareness techniques so that budget tables and technical annexes do not lose their original structure.
  3. Automatic solvency evaluation: The agent crosses the required turnover, ISO certifications, and previous experience with the real database of your company.
  4. Alert generation and executive summaries: You receive a clean report detailing the hot spots, delivery deadlines, scoring criteria, and detected financial risks.

The Real Impact on B2B Revenue

By implementing this intelligent agent in business development processes, the speed of response to government tenders changes drastically, allowing you to compete at the same level as large corporations.

  • 92% savings in analysis time: Reduces the reading process from days to just a few minutes per specification, freeing your engineers to focus on preparing the technical bid.
  • Multiplication of submitted tenders: Your capacity to evaluate opportunities increases exponentially, allowing you to detect contracts that previously went completely unnoticed.
  • Zero penalties for omission: The guardrails engine ensures that no risk clause, bond, or compulsory insurance requirement goes under your team's radar.
